reference_sql:
WITH quarterly AS (
  -- one row per quarter of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('quarter', paid_at) AS DATE) AS quarter, SUM(amount_eur) AS paid_eur
  FROM payments
  WHERE NOT refunded
    AND paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('quarter', paid_at) AS DATE)
), compared AS (
  -- one row per quarter, with the quarter before
  SELECT quarter, paid_eur, LAG(paid_eur) OVER (ORDER BY quarter) AS prev_paid_eur
  FROM quarterly
)
SELECT quarter, paid_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (paid_eur - prev_paid_eur) / prev_paid_eur, 1) AS change_pct
FROM compared

WITH quarterly AS (
  -- one row per quarter of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('quarter', paid_at) AS DATE) AS quarter, SUM(amount_eur) AS paid_eur
  FROM payments
  WHERE NOT refunded
    AND paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('quarter', paid_at) AS DATE)
)
SELECT q.quarter, q.paid_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (q.paid_eur - p.paid_eur) / p.paid_eur, 1) AS change_pct
FROM quarterly q
LEFT JOIN quarterly p ON p.quarter = q.quarter - INTERVAL 3 MONTH

solver.query:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('quarter', paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS quarter, SUM(amount_eur) AS paid_eur
  FROM payments
  WHERE NOT refunded
    AND (paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND (paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
), c AS (
  SELECT quarter, paid_eur, LAG(paid_eur) OVER (ORDER BY quarter) AS prev
  FROM q
)
SELECT quarter, paid_eur, ROUND(100.0 * (paid_eur - prev) / prev, 1) AS change_pct
FROM c
